chapters: Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios ka't gu Joel gu mar gu Petuel.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ dhi' kɨklhi'ñga'n gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ bɨx jix koi gu oidha'; gio ba' tu' gu oi'ñga'n dhi' gu tanoolh tattat.
Jano' ba' dhi' gu ñi'ook gu ma'nkam gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix jugi gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n jix jugi gu vaak; gio ba' gu ñi'ook jix jugi gu vaak ka't jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n jix duñia'; na gu' jix duñia' bɨx gu chuukug suudai' u'va kuiñcha gu bhóogɨt na gu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu chin.
Na gu' na gu' gu ja'tkam jix tɨ'ɨ gu oidha' jix kavɨk cham jɨɨ'ñdhidha'; gio ba' taatam maavɨt gu bhóogɨt maavɨt.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tasi' jix duñia' iigɨx; gio ba' bɨx cham kutun jix duñia'; mi' dhɨr mamraga'n jix duñia' chooto.
Jano' ba' jix xuaak tu' na ja'p gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook gu ux gu chio'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu o'o gu vaak na jix bhai' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios; gio ba' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios jix duu gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' yooxi' ka't gu jodai' jix duñia' gu oidha'; na gu' tiriik ka't gu jodai' jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' gu takarui' uubas jix duñia' gu jodai' gu ux tiriik gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam yooxi'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu tasi' jix duñia' iigɨx gu chuukug gio gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu chuukug; gio ba' jix duñia' bɨx gu u'u yooxi'; mi' dhɨr gu ux jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt gu ma'nkam gu chichio'ñ.

Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan; gio ba' jix duñia' gu vaak na jix bhai' jodai maa'nkar Jawatan; mi' dhɨr gu bhóogɨt jix koox jix bhaan maa'nkam Jawatan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios gu o'o gu vaak na jix bhai'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu maa'nkar jup tɨɨt gu takarui'; gio ba' jix duñia' daraa bɨx jix koi gu oidha' gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios duuñ gu Jawatan Dios.
Na gu' gu ñi'ook gu tanoolh na gu' mia'n gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios ɨlhdham na ja'p chajaañ gu ux gu Gɨ'kora' Jawatan.
Jano' ba' cham gu bhóogɨt na pai' ja'k oi'ñga'n jugi vupui bhaan gu vupui gu kutun gu ñi'ook gu vaak chulhiiñdha' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' kai'ñ jix duñia' bɨtaa'n gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt jix bɨɨx duu gu chuukug ulhña' gu suudai'; na gu' jix duñia' tiriik.
Na gu' gu takarui' jix duñia' gu vaakax gu suudai' gu jodai' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu vaakax na gu' cham chooto'n gu takarui' gio jix bɨɨx duu gu chuukug kakneer.
Jano' ba' tu' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios duuñ; na gu' gu tai jix duñia' gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki mɨmɨim jix duñia' bɨx gu u'u yooxi'.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax yooxi' jix duñia' gio tu'; na gu' jix duñia' gu takarui' gu suudai' gu tai jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ oidha' jix gaki.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu Sioon jix duñia' jix bhaan gu kavɨk; gio ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx jix koi gu oidha'; na gu' jupaabkamu'n gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios na gu' mia'n.

Jano' ba' gu tanoolh gu tukgam gu tanoolh toov ɨkgiga'n bhaan gu kakkavɨk biiñ na ja'p gu maa'nkar; gio ba' gu ja'tkam jix gɨ' jix kavɨk; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk dɨr gu suudai' ka't nɨidhim tu' mi' dhɨr ka't mɨɨjidha' gu takarui' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu takarui' gu tai bhaan jix duñia' mɨmɨim; gio ba' na ja'p u'uu pai' gu Edeen ka't gu oidha' vupui bhaan gu suudai' na ja'p oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr tu' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' na ja'p gu suudai' kavaayo; gio ba' na ja'p gu ja'tkam kavaayo jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' na ja'p gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' bhaan gu oi'ñga'n gu kakkavɨk; gio ba' na ja'p gu suudai' mɨmɨim gu tai gu jodai' jajar na ja'p jix kavɨk gu ja'tkam gu suudai' na ba' gu chuukug.
Jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu jodai' bɨx gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' na ja'p jix kavɨk jix duñia' na ja'p gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham jix tɨ'ɨ vaak jodai; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt cham gu ñi'ook gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' duiñchu' maa'n gu ñi'ook gu ux gu takarui'; gio ba' gu suudai' bhaan gu kuchii cham xibhɨk.
Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu ux kiicham gu ñi'ook gu ux gu ñi'ook jix tɨ'ɨ gu ux gu vaak jɨjɨkgɨm gu ux gu ñi'ook ɨ'xkum.
Jano' ba' vupui bhaan gu ñi'ook gu oidha' gu ñi'ook gu tɨkɨr; gio ba' gu tas gu masad gu chuukug gu si'avag gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios maa'n gu ñi'ook vupui bhaan ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham; na gu' mui'x gu ñi'ook jix kavɨk gu ñi'ook gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook; na gu' jix gɨ' gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook; jano' ba' chɨkka gu kutun gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu ux gu ñi'ook jano' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ñi'ook tu' bɨɨx bɨx gu i'ii'ñ bɨɨx gu maa'nkar suanda' gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu i'ii'ñ cham jajannulhi'ñ; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' i'ii'ñ na jix xoi'kam gu ñi'ook gu jodai' na ba' daak jix gɨ' xoi'kam na cham tu'x ai'ch gu bhóogɨt sɨlhka'n.
Jano' ba' chɨkka gu maa'nkar tu' gu ñi'ook jix duñia' kiicha' gu ñi'ook bhaan gu o'o gu vaak na jix bhai' na ba' gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug kuu'ñdham na jix kavɨk gu Sioon jix duñia' gu maa'nkar jup tɨɨt gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu masad jix duñia' kɨklhi'ñga'n jix duñia' a'aalh gu jodai'; gio ba' gu ñi'ook gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook.

Jano' ba' tɨjɨɨ'ñ ba'k jodai maa'nkar Jawatan gu chuukug jix bhaan ma'nkam Jawatan gu vaak na jix bhai' gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai'; gio ba' gu oi'ñga'n gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu ja'tkam cham gu chuukug gu jodai' gu maa'nkar na ba' chɨbɨɨp gu ñi'ook; mi' dhɨr gu ux gu ñi'ook jix duñia' a'ga tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam; jano' ba' duukat gu Jawatan Dios.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' gu oidha' uañi'ñka' gu ja'tkam.

Jano' ba' tu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios gu chuukug gu ja'tkam; gio ba' gu suudai' tu' jootsa' gu takarui' gu bhóogɨt bɨ'ñdhatu' ka't gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr cham pai' dhuuk gu oi'ñga'n gu bhóogɨt gu jodai' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp.

Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia' gu ñi'ook mi'x juu'ñ gu oidha' jix gaki oidha' jix gaki; gio ba' gu vupui ka't bhaan gu gɨ' suudai' gu ux na tu ibai' gu ñi'ook gu gɨ' suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu chuukug; na gu' jix tɨ'ɨ gu suudai' na gu' jix duu tu'x.
Jano' ba' gu oidha' cham jum i'obh; gio ba' gu chuukug gu oi'ñga'n; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' duñia' tu'x.
Jano' ba' gu vaakax yooxi' cham gu takarui'; na gu' gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki gu ñi'ook na gu' gu u'u jix duñia' gu i'bhɨ iigɨx gu tasi' jix duñia' gu i'bhɨ.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gio gu ma'nkam gu Sioon gu takarui' gu suudai' gu Jawatan Dios; na gu' tu' jix maa gu ñi'ook dhuuk jix bhai'x jix duñia' jix dhaav bhaan gu ñi'ook dhuuk gu jodai' gu tanoolh na ja'p gɨ'kora' ja'tkam.
Jano' ba' gu chuukug gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tiriik gu Jawatan jix duñia' suudai' u'va bɨ'ñdhatu'.
Jano' ba' gu bhóogɨt gu takarui' jix jugi gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook gu vaak gu ñi'ook; gio ba' jix gɨ' ja'tkam bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia' bhaan gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' jix duu jugi bɨɨx ka'm jix duñia' gu ñi'ook gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios kɨɨ'p bɨɨx gu ñi'ook; gio ba' cham pai' dhuuk mɨɨjidha' ka't gu ja'tkam jum xibhɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix maati' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Israeel dhi' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios cham cham tu'x jai'ch; gio ba' gu ja'tkam cham pai' dhuuk mɨɨjidha' ka't jum xibhɨ'ñ.

Jano' ba' ka't mi' dhɨr dhi' gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ bhaan bɨx gu chuukug jix duñia' gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ; gio ba' kɨklhi'ñga'n jix duñia' tɨɨtki' biipibop gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gio bhaan tu duukam bhaan ja'tkam na tu juan gu batoop na suudai' chɨt tu jiim gu Jix Chakui' I'ii'ñ mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu tɨkɨr gu oidha' gu ɨ'ɨr gu tai gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ kuubh.
Jano' ba' gu tas jix duñia' gu tukgam gu masad gu ɨ'ɨr va'k gu oi'ñga'n gu tanoolh jix gɨ' gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios.

Jano' ba' ka't no'x gu bhóogɨt gu tɨɨgɨ' gu Jawatan Dios ka't jix duñia'; na gu' gu kavɨk gu Sioon gu Jerusalem gu oi'ñga'n u'ua'tɨdham na ja'p gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook gu jodai' gu Jawatan Dios gu oi'ñga'n tɨɨgim.
Na gu' na gu' gu suudai' mii' dhɨr ja'tkam gu tanoolh mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt gu suudai' gu i'ii'ñ na jix bhai'x gu Judaa gu Jerusalem.

Jano' ba' gu ñi'ook gu bhóogɨt chɨbɨɨp gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai' gu ñi'ook ba'k ñi'ook na jir bhai' bɨɨx kuiñcha gu ja'tkam gu Israeel gu maa'nkar jix duñia' tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ja'tkam jix duñia' gu oidha'.
Jano' ba' mi'x juu'ñ mamai'chɨk bhaan gu ja'tkam a'aalh jix maa gu ux ganai' jix duñia' gu suudai' gu ux suudai' u'va na ba' i'i.
Jano' ba' gio gu oi'ñga'n no'ñ tu' bɨɨx gu takarui' gu Tiro gu Sidoon gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu oi'ñga'n gu suudai' tu' gu bhóogɨt xoi'kam gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt tu' gu chuukug gu bhóogɨt bhaan mo'o.
Na gu' na gu' jix duñia' baabuk jix toja jodai jix uam jodai tu'x a'bhar gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ jix duñia' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' jix duñia' gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu ma'nkam gu Jerusalem gu ma'nkam gu Griegos gu ux gu bhóogɨt gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ.
Jano' ba' gu suudai' gu oi'ñga'n tu' pai' jix duñia' gu jodai' gu bhóogɨt bhaan mo'o.
Jano' ba' bi'iix gu ma'nkam ma'nkam u'uuvɨ gu novɨ gu ma'nkam gu Judaa gu takarui' gu Sabeos gu ja'tkam gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ; na gu' gu Jawatan Dios tu' tu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Pregonad dhi' tɨjɨɨ'ñ chɨbɨɨp jix duñia' bhɨɨ'ñdham jix duñia' jix kavɨk gu suudai' gu bhóogɨt bɨx gu chichio'ñ bhɨɨ'ñdham.
Jano' ba' xoi'kam u'uux gu takarui' u'u kavɨk gu jodai'; gio ba' gu takarui'; mi' dhɨr jix kavɨk jix duñia'.
Jano' ba' jum daa'ñ gu bhóogɨt chɨbɨɨp bɨx xikoolh gu chuukug; gio ba' gu vupui gu kutun gu ñi'ook gu Jawatan Dios jix kavɨk.
Jano' ba' chɨbɨɨp gu suudai' jix tɨ'ɨ gu suudai' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu oi'ñga'n na ba' gu ñi'ook bɨx chɨbɨɨp xikoolh.
Na gu' mi'x juu'ñ gu jodai' na gu' gu ja'tkam tu' gu jodai'; gio ba' gu bhóogɨt jix duñia'; na gu' gu chuukug jix bhuup gu jodai' gu ñi'ook; na gu' gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ tu' na cham jir bhai'.
Jano' ba' gu Mukos gu ja'tkam gu suudai' gu takarui'; na gu' mia'n gu tanoolh gu Jawatan Dios gu suudai' gu takarui'.
Jano' ba' gu tas gu masad gu chuukug gu si'avag gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu ñi'ook.
Jano' ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix duñia' dɨr gu Sioon maa'n gu ñi'ook dɨr gu Jerusalem jix duñia' gu tɨkɨr gu oidha'; gu' gu Jawatan Dios ka't nɨɨra gu ja'tkam gu kavɨk gu ma'nkam gu Israeel.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' tu' jix duñia' gu Jawatan Dios gu bhóogɨt gu Sioon gu kavɨk jix bhaan Gɨ'kora'; gio ba' ka't gu Jerusalem abhaar gu ñi'ook cham jix duñia' gu oi'ñga'n gu ux.

Jano' ba' ka't mii' dhɨr gu ñi'ook gu kakkavɨk jix duñia' gu bhóogɨt bii'm gu ux bɨx gu takarui' gu Judaa gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu suudai'; gio ba' gu jodai' suudai' buusñi gu vaak gu Jawatan Dios jix suudai' duu gu suudai' gu jodai'.
Jano' ba' gu Ejipto ka't gu jodai' gu Edom ka't gu bhóogɨt gu ñi'ook oidha' jix gaki gu ux jix duñia' gu kutun gu ma'nkam gu Judaa; na gu' jix duñia' gu oidha' gu ɨ'ɨr gu tasi'.
Gu' gu' gu Judaa na ba' bɨɨx tas ka't gu tɨjɨɨ'ñ gu Jerusalem gu oi'ñga'n.
Jano' ba' gu jodai' gu ɨ'ɨr cham gu bhóogɨt; gio ba' gu Jawatan Dios jix koi gu Sioon.
